commits.subject: net: fixed Delphi compilation of TSChannelClient.fClientCertificate
commits.body:
The field type resolved to Winapi.Windows.PCCERT_CONTEXT, since the private
uses clause of mormot.net.sock.windows.inc comes later in scope, whereas
CertDuplicateCertificateContext() returns mormot.core.os.security.PCCERT_CONTEXT:
Delphi 13 failed with E2010 at line 2940, then F2084 internal error D12814.
Qualified as the peer variable already is a few lines above.
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: net: THttpAsyncServer rejects an endless header or chunk size line at once
commits.body:
THttpRequestContext.ProcessParseLine() only checked MaxHttpHeaderLineSize once
the #13 of a line had arrived: a header or chunk size line which never ends was
buffered without any bound by THttpAsyncServer, whatever HeadersMaximumSize or
MaximumAllowedContentLength said (THttpServer is not affected: SockRecvLn()
rejects any line over 16KB).
- ProcessParseLine() now rejects a line with no #13 yet as soon as it is longer
  than MaxHttpHeaderLineSize
- ProcessRead() now returns true on hrsErrorRejected, so that the rejection is
  answered at once: it was only noticed with the next input, i.e. never when
  the client just waits - this also applies to the existing rejections, e.g. a
  too long line with its #13, or a missing #10
- test: an endless header line and an endless chunk size line get a 400
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: net: THttpAsyncServer request options now apply to every kept-alive request
commits.body:
THttpRequestContext.Reset clears Options, and HttpInit did not restore them:
on a kept-alive THttpAsyncServer connection, hsoHeadersUnfiltered and
hsoHeadersSanitize only applied to the first request.
- HttpInit now sets fHttp.Options from fDefaultRequestOptions, so AfterCreate
  and AfterWrite both get them
- test: three kept-alive requests with hsoHeadersUnfiltered on both server
  families, checking that they share one connection
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: net: MaximumAllowedContentLength now bounds a chunked body buffered in memory
commits.body:
ContentMaxSize - the running total which bounds a chunked body - was only set
when OnBodyDownload supplied a stream. Buffered as plain Content, i.e. with no
OnBodyDownload event or when it returned nil, a chunked body could grow up to
MaxHttpInMemSize (1GB) whatever MaximumAllowedContentLength said, since the
header check only applies to an explicit Content-Length.
- THttpAsyncServer and THttpServer now set ContentMaxSize for every request,
  before OnBodyDownload is called
- THttpServer reports the in-memory overflow as 413, as GetBodyStream does
- tests: in-memory chunked body at the 39999/40000 boundary, with OnBodyDownload
  returning nil and with no event at all, on both server families
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: net: fixed TDhcpServer broadcast response address
commits.body:
- with no relay, OFFER/ACK were broadcasted to the scope broadcast address,
  which is not received by a client with no IPv4 address yet reading from a
  regular UDP socket: RFC 2131 4.1 expects 0xffffffff, as already done for NAK
- removed the now unused TDhcpServerThread.fClientBroadcast field
commits.author: zen010101
